question:
The marks scored by 10 students are given below.

10, 13, 17, 11, 11, 13, 14, 16, 13, 13

The mode of the data is:
solution:
**Given:**

10, 13, 17, 11, 11, 13, 14, 16, 13, 13

**Formula Used:**

Mode = The value occurring most frequently in the data set.

**Calculation:**

⇒ Frequency of 10 = 1

⇒ Frequency of 11 = 2

⇒ Frequency of 13 = 4

⇒ Frequency of 14 = 1

⇒ Frequency of 16 = 1

⇒ Frequency of 17 = 1

⇒ Maximum frequency = 4 (value 13)

**∴ The correct answer is 13.**
